<h2>Select sjSDM Regularization</h2>

<h3>Description</h3>

<p>Selects one regularization candidate from repeat-level tuning summaries.
</p>


<h3>Usage</h3>

<pre><code class='language-R'>select_sjsdm_regularization(
  data_tuning_summary = NULL,
  selection_metric = "negative_log_likelihood_per_response"
)
</code></pre>


<h3>Arguments</h3>

<table role = "presentation">
<tr><td><code id="data_tuning_summary">data_tuning_summary</code></td>
<td>
<p>Repeat-by-candidate table returned by
[summarise_sjsdm_tuning_candidates()].</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="selection_metric">selection_metric</code></td>
<td>
<p>Metric minimized during selection. Defaults to normalized held-out negative
log likelihood, &quot;negative_log_likelihood_per_response&quot;.</p>
</td></tr>
</table>


<h3>Details</h3>

<p>A candidate is eligible only when every represented repeat is complete.
The selection metric is averaged equally across repeats. Lower values are
preferred, and exact ties are resolved by lexical candidate identifier.
</p>


<h3>Value</h3>

<p>One-row tibble containing the selected candidate parameters, criterion name
and value, repeat count, deterministic candidate rank, and regularization
source.
</p>


<h3>Examples</h3>

<pre><code class='language-R'>## Not run:
select_sjsdm_regularization(data_tuning_summary = data_summary)

## End(Not run)
</code></pre>
